record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Characterize those Banach lattice algebras A for which there exists any faithful algebra homomorphism, preserving finite suprema and infima, into some space of regular operators, \({\mathcal L}^r(E)\) . Note that the existence of such a representation does not imply that the left regular representation possesses these properties, see [ 20 ]. In particular it seems to be open as to whether or not every Banach lattice algebra can be represented in this manner. If such a representation exists, when can it be taken to be isometric, either for the regular or operator norm on \({\mathcal L}^r(E)\) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let a Banach lattice algebra be a Banach lattice $A$ which is simultaneously a Banach algebra and in which the product of any two positive elements is positive. For a Dedekind complete Banach lattice $E$, let $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ denote the Banach lattice algebra of regular operators on $E$ (i.e. linear combinations of positive operators), equipped with the regular norm $\|T\|_r = \||T|\|$ and pointwise lattice operations.

A faithful lattice representation of $A$ is an injective algebra homomorphism $\pi : A \to \mathcal{L}^r(E)$, for some Dedekind complete Banach lattice $E$, that also preserves finite suprema and infima (equivalently, is a lattice homomorphism).

Solve the following:

(1) Characterize those Banach lattice algebras $A$ that admit a faithful lattice representation in this sense.

(2) Decide whether every Banach lattice algebra admits such a faithful lattice representation.

(3) Whenever such a representation exists, characterize the Banach lattice algebras $A$ for which it can be chosen to be isometric, either with respect to the regular norm on $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$ or with respect to the operator norm on $\mathcal{L}^r(E)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Question (2) — whether every Banach lattice algebra admits a faithful lattice representation as regular operators on some Dedekind complete Banach lattice — has been answered in the negative: Dales and de Jeu exhibited unital Banach lattice algebras of dimension 2 with no such faithful representation. The general characterization problem (1) and the isometric refinement (3) appear to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: Whether every Banach lattice algebra can be faithfully represented as regular operators on some Dedekind complete Banach lattice is a central question.
status_evidence.claim: States the representation question as a central open problem in the area.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:1812.11833 (Dales–de Jeu)
status_evidence.snippet: Unital Banach lattice algebras of dimension 2 are exhibited that admit no faithful representation as regular operators on any Dedekind complete vector lattice.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves negatively the sub-question of whether every Banach lattice algebra admits a faithful lattice representation.
